nodes.label: Automatically activate the transcribe skill when user mentions keywords such as 转写, 字幕, 听悟, 在线视频, 把视频变成文字, 音频转文字, 视频转文字, yt-dlp
Perform dependency self‑check (Step 0) before each invocation: determine SKILL_ROOT, run setup.sh, verify .env, resolve cookie path
Confirm or set OUTPUT_DIR (Step 0.5) before each run; ask user if empty/invalid, write back to scripts/pipeline.py and scripts/get_result.py
Every yt‑dlp command must include the cookies option (--cookies $SKILL_ROOT/cookies.txt)
On critical error codes (BRK.InvalidService, BRK.OverdueService, BRK.OverdueTenant, BRK.InvalidTenant) abort the task and display a clear warning to the user
If getting the result fails, fallback in order: retry the Tingwu API, download transcript from OSS using oss_transcript key, then use the temporary Tingwu URL
